name: koa
description: Build async web applications with Koa: middleware composition, routers, body parsing, and error handling with the koa ecosystem.

capabilities.name: koa-app
capabilities.description: Scaffold and run a Koa application with router and bodyparser.
examples: npm init -y && npm install koa koa-router koa-bodyparser

capabilities.name: verify-endpoints
capabilities.description: Test Koa endpoints with curl including JSON bodies and errors.

examples.input: Scaffold a Koa API with one route
examples.output: npm init -y && npm install koa koa-router, write app.js with a router, then node app.js and curl -i http://localhost:3000/.
Add router.allowedMethods() and a final catch-all middleware setting ctx.status = 404.
